messages:
deploy-bot: Hotfix requested for service `kv-cache-eu1` -> prod-eu1. Symptom: transient 503s under burst traffic after yesterday's quant change. Patch: reduce in-memory cache size + tighten eviction. Owner: maya. Runbook: https://go/internal/runbooks/kv-cache-hotfix

maya: short summary: repro in staging with burst tool. Hotfix validated, reduces cache soft-limit and forces earlier compaction. Need expedited rollout, customers affected in EU.

drew: Ack. Please paste rollback steps and abort criteria.

ops-lead: Rollback tested in staging:
```
kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deployment/kv-cache --to-revision=5
kubectl scale deploy/kv-cache --replicas=6
```
Abort if 5xx >1% for 5m or memory >85% on canary nodes. Require 2 approvals + ops-lead.

olga: +1 for expedited, will monitor 5xx and p95.

drew: +1, I can take pager for 20m post-deploy.

deploy-bot: Approval flow: react with :thumbsup: to approve. Auto-start in 4m if 2 approvals.

maya: Draft release note: https://docs.redwood/internal/release-notes/kv-cache-hotfix-2026-03-23 (RCA + rollback).

deploy-bot: Approval threshold reached. Initiating canary: image registry.redwood/kv-cache:hotfix-2026-03-23-a -> 10% traffic to pool-eu-canary.

olga: Canary metrics: 503s down from 3.8% -> 0.5% in 4m. no OOMs.

deploy-bot: Canary increased to 50% after stability. Full rollout scheduled after 15m stable window.

ops-lead: Model pin applied for routing to `v1.3-quant-safe`. If errors spike >2% abort and run rollback.

drew: Observability green. Recommend proceed to 100% after window.

deploy-bot: Full rollout started: 100% traffic -> registry.redwood/kv-cache:hotfix-2026-03-23-a across eu1.

maya: Post-check: 30m after full rollout, error rate 0.2%, p95 stable. Ending pager watch in 10m. Thanks team. :tada:
